description: Opens on a hero shot, then the three-section app demo with a reaction cut between and after each: hero, app pt 1, reaction 1, app pt 2, reaction 2, app pt 3, reaction 3, outro. The hero is a b-roll clip of the same subject as the demo — scoped to the brief's topic by SubCategory via require_topic_match (a burgers brief opens on a burgers b-roll, not an app clip), with quality_score ranking the most striking clip to the front. The three app slots scope to the brief's feature (subtype) and are pinned in order by shot_type (Pt 1/2/3) and to the topic; reactions carry an arc via slot emotions; the cta slot is the outro (branded end-card when with_endcard is on). Set Topic (e.g. Burgers) and Feature (Features) on the brief.

slots.notes: Opening hero shot — a b-roll clip of the same subject as the demo, not an app clip. require_topic_match scopes it to the brief's topic by SubCategory (e.g. Burgers); quality_score ranks the best clip to the front. City-scoped like all b-roll.
Section 1 of the app demo. match_feature scopes it to the brief's feature (subtype); require_shot_type pins this slot to the clip tagged shot_type='Pt 1'.
First reaction, between sections 1 and 2 — the 'wait, what?' intrigue beat. Emotions set on the slot (not the brief mood) so the reactions differ. Reactions carry no city, hence city_agnostic_ok.
Section 2 of the app demo. require_shot_type pins this slot to the clip tagged shot_type='Pt 2'.
Second reaction, between sections 2 and 3 — the delight beat. Dedupe refuses to reuse an earlier reaction's clip or any sharing its checksum.
Section 3 of the app demo. require_shot_type pins this slot to the clip tagged shot_type='Pt 3'.
Third reaction, after section 3 — the closing beat before the outro. A third distinct reaction clip; dedupe keeps it different from reactions 1 and 2.
The outro. with_endcard on points this at the branded end-card (rotating across the CTA folder); off, it holds a topic clip behind the generated CTA line.

captions.notes: Names the place in the hero shot. Dropped if the clip has no place_name.
Names the feature. Dropped if the opening app clip has no subtype.

captions.pattern: Find it in Big City Travel Guide
captions.notes: Fixed copy. Suppressed automatically when the branded end-card fills this slot.
